title: Marketplace listing & coordinated launch playbook for AWS / Azure / GCP
creator: Leah Moreno
description:
Objective: Prepare, review, and publish marketplace listings for Redwood Inference on AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and Google Cloud Marketplace. Coordinate release notes, legal attestations, billing/SKU alignment, and GTM assets so listings go live in the same 48-72 hour launch window.

Scope: Write listing copy, localize to en-US/en-GB, assemble screenshots & video clips, finalize pricing SKUs and billing metadata, produce launch notes and FAQ, obtain legal/compliance approvals, validate private deployment artifacts for marketplaces that require image/container submission, and schedule coordinated publish time with cloud partners.

Out of scope: Building new product features, long-form product documentation (beyond landing page / FAQ), post-launch marketing campaign execution (handled by growth).

Success metrics: Listings published on all 3 marketplaces within window; marketplace listing page views >= 5k in first 30 days; first 10 customers via marketplaces on dedicated/private SKUs; no critical legal issues post-publish.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Final copy approved by PM + Legal + Sales engineering for each marketplace.
- All required artifacts (screenshots, 1-minute demo video, 1-page quickstart PDF) uploaded and validated in partner consoles.
- Billing SKUs registered and test purchases verified in sandbox for each cloud.
- Release notes entry merged and included in product changelog with links to marketplace pages.
- Ops runbook for first 72 hours created and shared with on-call rotation.

Deliverables & owners (high level):
- Marketplace copy & bullets (PM: Arjun)
- Screens & demo assets (Design: Maya)
- Billing/SKU registration (Finance/Revops: Carla)
- Technical packaging (Engineering: Raj)
- Legal/compliance attestation (Legal: Priya)
- Release notes + changelog integration (Docs: Omar)
- Launch coordination timeline & communications (PM: Leah)

Initial timeline (target):
- 2026-02-26: Draft copy + asset list (done)
- 2026-03-03: Design deliverables & video rough cut (in review)
- 2026-03-09: Legal sign-off on attestation (blocked briefly, resolved 3/10)
- 2026-03-12: Billing/SKU sandbox verification (passed)
- 2026-03-18: Finalize listings in partner consoles (ready for publish)
- 2026-03-20: Coordinated publish window (target)

Checklist (mark when complete):
- [x] Draft marketplace copy (PM)
- [x] Asset request sent to Design + Media
- [x] Demo video 60s rough cut (Design)
- [x] Quickstart PDF (Docs)
- [x] PRD / Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MP/Marketplace+Launch+2026
- [x] GH PR for release-notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421
- [x] Billing SKUs created and verified in sandbox
- [ ] AWS listing submitted (pending partner portal final review)
- [ ] Azure listing in publisher portal (waiting legal attestation file)
- [ ] GCP listing draft ready (confirm container image manifest)
- [ ] Send coordinated publish email to partner contacts and internal stakeholders

Notes / risks: Partner portal queues can add 24-72 hours to approval. Azure requires attestation PDF signed and embedded — legal requested an additional clause which added a 48-hour delay (resolved 2026-03-10). Engineering needs to confirm container image scanning results before GCP submission; expected by 2026-03-13.

Known links: Confluence PRD above, GH PR for release notes, design Figma board: https://www.figma.com/file/xYz123/marketplace-assets, Drive folder with final screenshots: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c
